name: Shape
description: Represents an object in the drawing layer, such as an AutoShape, freeform, OLE object, or picture.
remarks: > The following examples describe how to: - Return an existing shape on a slide, indexed by name or number. - Return a newly created shape on a slide. - Return a shape within the selection. - Return the slide title and other placeholders on a slide. - Return the shapes attached to the ends of a connector. - Return the default shape for a presentation. - Return a newly created freeform. - Return a single shape from within a group. - Return a newly formed group of shapes.
example:
Set myDocument = ActivePresentation.Slides(1)

myDocument.Shapes(1).Flip msoFlipHorizontal

myDocument.Shapes("Rectangle 1").Flip msoFlipHorizontal

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the four-character creator code for the application in which the specified object was created. For example, if the object was created in Microsoft PowerPoint, this property returns the hexadecimal number 50575054. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Adjustments
properties.description: Returns an Adjustments object that contains adjustment values for all the adjustments in the specified shape. Applies to any Shape object that represents an AutoShape, WordArt, or a connector. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoShapeType
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape type for the specified Shape object, which must represent an AutoShape other than a line, freeform drawing, or connector. Read/write.

properties.name: BlackWhiteMode
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates how the specified shape appears when the presentation is viewed in black-and-white mode. Read/write.

properties.name: Callout
properties.description: Returns a CalloutFormat object that contains callout formatting properties for the specified shape. Applies to Shape or ShapeRange objects that represent line callouts. Read-only.

properties.name: ConnectionSiteCount
properties.description: Returns the number of connection sites on the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: Connector
properties.description: Determines whether the specified shape is a connector. Read-only.

properties.name: ConnectorFormat
properties.description: Returns a ConnectorFormat object that contains connector formatting properties. Applies to Shape or ShapeRange objects that represent connectors. Read-only.

properties.name: Fill
properties.description: Returns a FillFormat object that contains fill formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: GroupItems
properties.description: Returns a GroupShapes object that represents the individual shapes in the specified group. Use the Item method of the GroupShapes object to return a single shape from the group. Read-only.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the specified object, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: HorizontalFlip
properties.description: Returns whether the specified shape is flipped around the horizontal axis. Read-only.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the distance in points from the left edge of the shape's bounding box to the left edge of the slide. Read/write.

properties.name: Line
properties.description: Returns a LineFormat object that contains line formatting properties for the specified shape. (For a line, the LineFormat object represents the line itself; for a shape with a border, the LineFormat object represents the border.) Read-only.

properties.name: LockAspectRatio
properties.description: Determines whether the specified shape retains its original proportions when you resize it. Read/write.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: When a shape is created, Microsoft PowerPoint automatically assigns it a name in the form ShapeType Number, where ShapeType identifies the type of shape or AutoShape, and Number is an integer that's unique within the collection of shapes on the slide. For example, the automatically generated names of the shapes on a slide could be Placeholder 1, Oval 2, and Rectangle 3. To avoid conflict with automatically assigned names, don't use the form ShapeType Number for user-defined names, where ShapeType is a value that is used for automatically generated names, and Number is any positive integer. A shape range must contain exactly one shape. Read/write.

properties.name: Nodes
properties.description: Returns a ShapeNodes collection that represents the geometric description of the specified shape. Applies to Shape objects that represent freeform drawings.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of degrees the specified shape is rotated around the z-axis. Read/write.

properties.name: PictureFormat
properties.description: Returns a PictureFormat object that contains picture formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns a ShadowFormat object that contains shadow formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: TextEffect
properties.description: Returns a TextEffectFormat object that contains text-effect formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: TextFrame
properties.description: Returns a TextFrame object that contains the alignment and anchoring properties for the specified shape or master text style.

properties.name: ThreeD
properties.description: Returns a ThreeDFormat object that contains 3D - effect formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the distance from the top edge of the shape's bounding box to the top edge of the document. Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the type of shape or shapes in a range of shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: VerticalFlip
properties.description: Determines whether the specified shape is flipped around the vertical axis. Read-only.

properties.name: Vertices
properties.description: Returns the coordinates of the specified freeform drawing's vertices (and control points for Bzier curves) as a series of coordinate pairs. Read-only.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets the visibility of the specified object or the formatting applied to the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the specified object, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: ZOrderPosition
properties.description: Returns the position of the specified shape in the z-order. Read-only.

properties.name: OLEFormat
properties.description: Returns an OLEFormat object that contains OLE formatting properties for the specified shape. Applies to Shape or ShapeRange objects that represent OLE objects. Read-only.

properties.name: LinkFormat
properties.description: Returns a LinkFormat object that contains the properties that are unique to linked OLE objects. Read-only.

properties.name: PlaceholderFormat
properties.description: Returns a PlaceholderFormat object that contains the properties that are unique to placeholders. Read-only.

properties.name: AnimationSettings
properties.description: Returns an AnimationSettings object that represents all the special effects you can apply to the animation of the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: ActionSettings
properties.description: Returns an ActionSettings object that contains information about what action occurs when the user clicks or moves the mouse over the specified shape or text range during a slide show. Read-only.

properties.name: Tags
properties.description: Returns a Tags object that represents the tags for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: MediaType
properties.description: Returns the OLE media type. Read-only.

properties.name: HasTextFrame
properties.description: Returns whether the specified shape has a text frame. Read-only.

properties.name: AlternativeText
properties.description: Returns or sets the alternative text associated with a shape in a Web presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: HasTable
properties.description: Returns whether the specified shape is a table. Read-only.

properties.name: Table
properties.description: Returns a Table object that represents a table in a shape or in a shape range. Read-only.

properties.name: Child
properties.description: MsoTrue if the shape is a child shape or if all shapes in a shape range are child shapes of the same parent. Read-only.

properties.name: ParentGroup
properties.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the common parent shape of a child shape or a range of child shapes.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Returns a Long that identifies the shape or range of shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: CustomerData
properties.description: Returns a CustomerData object. Read-only.

properties.name: TextFrame2
properties.description: Returns the TextFrame2 object associated with the specified Shape object that contains the alignment and anchoring properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: HasChart
properties.description: Returns whether the shape represented by the specified object contains a chart. Read-only.

properties.name: ShapeStyle
properties.description: Sets or returns the shape style index for the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: BackgroundStyle
properties.description: Sets or returns the background style of the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: SoftEdge
properties.description: Returns the soft edge format for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: Glow
properties.description: Returns a GlowFormat object that contains glow formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: Reflection
properties.description: Returns the reflection format for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: Chart
properties.description: Returns a Chart object of the current Shape object. Read-only.

properties.name: HasSmartArt
properties.description: Returns True if the current Shape object contains a SmartArt diagram. Read-only.

properties.name: SmartArt
properties.description: Returns a Microsoft Office SmartArt object that represents the SmartArt diagram of the Shape object. Read-only.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the slide title. Read-only.

properties.name: MediaFormat
properties.description: Allows access to the new audio or video object. Read-only.

properties.name: IsNarration
properties.description: Specifies whether the specified shape range contains a narration. Read/write.

properties.name: InkXML
properties.description: Returns a String that contains the InkActionML associated with the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: HasInkXML
properties.description: Returns an MsoTriState enumeration value that indicates whether the specified shape contains ink XML that can be retrieved via the Shape.InkXML property. Read-only.

properties.name: GraphicStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoGraphicStyleIndex constant that represents the style of an SVG graphic. Read/write.

properties.name: Model3D
properties.description: Returns a Model3DFormat object that represents the 3D properties of a 3D model object. Read-only.

properties.name: Decorative
properties.description: Sets or returns the decorative flag for the specified object. Read/write.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies to the specified shape formatting that's been copied by using the PickUp method.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified Shape object.

methods.name: Flip
methods.description: Flips the specified shape around its horizontal or vertical axis.

parameters.name: FlipCmd
parameters.description: Specifies whether the shape is to be flipped horizontally or vertically.

methods.name: IncrementLeft
methods.description: Moves the specified shape horizontally by the specified number of points.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shape is to be moved horizontally, in points. A positive value moves the shape to the right; a negative value moves it to the left.

methods.name: IncrementRotation
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the z-axis by the specified number of degrees. Use the Rotation property to set the absolute rotation of the shape.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shape is to be rotated horizontally, in degrees. A positive value rotates the shape clockwise; a negative value rotates it counterclockwise.

methods.name: IncrementTop
methods.description: Moves the specified shape vertically by the specified number of points.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shape is to be moved vertically, in points. A positive value moves the shape down; a negative value moves it up.

methods.name: PickUp
methods.description: Copies the formatting of the specified shape. Use the Apply method to apply the copied formatting to another shape.

methods.name: RerouteConnections
methods.description: Reroutes connectors so that they take the shortest possible path between the shapes they connect. To do this, the RerouteConnections method may detach the ends of a connector and reattach them to different connecting sites on the connected shapes.

methods.name: ScaleHeight
methods.signature: ScaleHeight(Factor As Single, RelativeToOriginalSize As MsoTriState, [fScale As MsoScaleFrom])
methods.description: Scales the height of the shape by a specified factor.

parameters.name: Factor
parameters.description: Specifies the ratio between the height of the shape after you resize it and the current or original height. For example, to make a rectangle 50 percent larger, specify 1.5 for this argument.

parameters.name: RelativeToOriginalSize
parameters.description: Specifies whether the shape is scaled relative to its current or original size.

parameters.name: fScale
parameters.description: The part of the shape that retains its position when the shape is scaled.

methods.name: ScaleWidth
methods.signature: ScaleWidth(Factor As Single, RelativeToOriginalSize As MsoTriState, [fScale As MsoScaleFrom])
methods.description: Scales the width of the shape by a specified factor. For pictures and OLE objects, you can indicate whether you want to scale the shape relative to the original size or relative to the current size. Shapes other than pictures and OLE objects are always scaled relative to their current width.

parameters.name: Factor
parameters.description: Specifies the ratio between the width of the shape after you resize it and the current or original width. For example, to make a rectangle 50 percent larger, specify 1.5 for this argument.

parameters.name: RelativeToOriginalSize
parameters.description: Specifies whether a shape is scaled relative to its current or original size.

parameters.name: fScale
parameters.description: The part of the shape that retains its position when the shape is scaled.

methods.name: SetShapesDefaultProperties
methods.description: Applies the formatting for the specified shape to the default shape. Shapes created after this method has been used will have this formatting applied to them by default.

methods.name: Ungroup
methods.description: Ungroups any grouped shapes in the specified shape or range of shapes. Disassembles pictures and OLE objects within the specified shape or range of shapes. Returns the ungrouped shapes as a single ShapeRange object.

methods.name: ZOrder
methods.description: Moves the specified shape in front of or behind other shapes in the collection (that is, changes the shape's position in the z-order).

parameters.name: ZOrderCmd
parameters.description: Specifies where to move the specified shape relative to the other shapes.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Deletes the specified object and places it on the Clipboard.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the specified object to the Clipboard.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the specified object.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.description: Specifies whether the selection replaces any previous selection.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the specified Shape object, adds the new shape to the Shapes collection, and then returns a new ShapeRange object. The duplicated objects are placed at the end of the Shapes collection.

methods.name: ConvertTextToSmartArt
methods.description: Converts text in a Shape object to a SmartArt diagram.

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.description: The SmartArt layout to convert text to.

methods.name: PickupAnimation
methods.description: Picks up all animation from the Shape object.

methods.name: ApplyAnimation
methods.description: Applies the last picked up animation to the Shape object.

methods.name: UpgradeMedia
methods.description: Converts a legacy media object to an updated media object.
